name: @tx5dr/cw-keyer-pin
description: Native N-API addon for direct DTR/RTS pin control via TIOCMBIS/TIOCMBIC. Works around @serialport/bindings-cpp TIOCMSET ENOTTY failures on certain Linux/tty drivers (notably CP2105 ECI on kernel 6.17).

scripts.postinstall: node -e "if(process.platform==='linux'){const r=require('child_process').spawnSync('node-gyp',['rebuild'],{stdio:'inherit',shell:true});if(r.status!==0)console.warn('@tx5dr/cw-keyer-pin: native build failed; falling back to serialport.set().')}else{console.log('@tx5dr/cw-keyer-pin: skipping native build on '+process.platform)}"
